# pve_firewall_alias (Data Source)

Reads a single IP or network alias from `GET /cluster/firewall/aliases/{name}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_firewall_alias" "office" {
  name = "office"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Alias name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String) Network/IP specification in CIDR format the alias resolves to.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment, or null when the alias has none.
